name: TDspEsp32
description: Teensy-side driver for the on-board ESP32-DevKitC: reset/boot-strap control and a host-driven flash bridge (PC esptool talks to the ESP32 through the Teensy over Serial7). Emulates the auto-reset EN capacitor in firmware so download-mode entry is reliable with no button presses. Drop into any T-DSP project to (re)program the ESP32 on demand.
